name: Tír
text: Tír is the Irish word for land. It opens countless real and imagined place-names as their first element. English writers once anglicized the element as Tyr-. The dictionary sends the plain sense of the word to its mag entry. The element marks territories and otherworld lands alike. Readers meet it across the whole place-name alphabet of this book.

attributes.attribute: first element of countless place-names, anglicized Tyr-

okr.objective: Tír is the Irish word for land
